quote: I'm grateful that we have people in our community who have continued to push to better our neighborhoods. This is a huge win for all our residents. The idea of having a more connected Pensacola that is walkable and provides for a more active lifestyle is encouraging. I'm excited to see what this project holds next for our community.
author: Ashlee Hofberger
title: Commissioner, District 4
organization: Escambia County Board of County Commissioners
